description: Export a Google Sheets spreadsheet to csv or xlsx into blob storage and return its sheet_blob_key. Runs as a background job: a missing id or unsupported format is refused at once; otherwise dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the sheet_blob_key (with namespace, filename and the account used) arrives via a follow-up message once the export completes (read it any time with service_interface::job_service::get_job). Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Export a Google Sheets spreadsheet through Drive into platform blob storage as CSV for the default tab or XLSX for the complete multi-tab workbook. Completion delivers a sheet blob key for email attachments or downstream plugins. Use this when a Google-native spreadsheet must become a portable file.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the export (job_id, status queued); the finished job's result is sheet_blob_key (a blob-storage reference to the exported bytes), namespace, filename and account. Completion is delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Say the export is running. Once it completes: confirm the export and format used. The sheet_blob_key references potentially sensitive corporate content — surface it for downstream use but do not treat it as public.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Export a Google Sheets spreadsheet into blob storage.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: At dispatch: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id or format is not csv/xlsx. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.unknown_account: `account` names no connected account. In the finished job: gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist; gsuite.permission_denied, gsuite.rate_limited or gsuite.auth_expired: Google refused the export. gsuite.invalid_params at dispatch can also mean the session_id/flow_id context is missing. gsuite.api_error at dispatch means the job could not be queued (AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass format as csv or xlsx. gsuite.not_found: the spreadsheet may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error at dispatch: retry once platform startup has completed.
